Outspokin' Friday Canal Ride

Augusta, GA · Summerville · Gravel · Mountain bike · Mixed

Beginner friendly

Outspokin' Friday Canal Ride is a gravel and mountain bike group ride in Augusta, GA. It rolls every Friday at 6:00 pm from Outspokin' Bicycles. About 20 miles, conversation pace.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: conversation pace.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Outspokin' Friday Canal Ride group ride

Easy out-and-back on the Augusta Canal towpath. About 20 miles at a talking pace on a mountain, gravel or hybrid bike. Runs through winter too; bring lights once it gets dark early.
